blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
We introduce LIFT , a unified image-to-video generation framework that complements camera control with L ayout- I n- F u T ure control, enabling users to specify what should appear in a future view and where it should appear.
This addresses a practical need in controllable video generation: given an initial image, users often care not only about how the camera moves, but also about what the scene should look like at key future moments, especially the final frame.
Existing camera controls specify viewpoint trajectories, while text prompts provide only coarse semantic guidance; neither precisely determines the content and spatial layout of future views.
This limitation becomes particularly pronounced under large viewpoint changes, where the camera reveals regions that are not visible in the first frame.
LIFT therefore uses the last-frame layout as an explicit control signal for the desired future scene.
Since learning from such sparse layout guidance is substantially more challenging than conditioning on dense per-frame layouts, we introduce on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) to transfer the control capability of a dense-layout teacher to a last-frame-layout student.
We further curate LIFT-Vista , a dataset featuring large viewpoint changes with camera and temporally consistent layout annotations.
Experiments show that LIFT improves video quality, future-layout controllability, and camera controllability over other methods.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了LIFT,一个统一的图像到视频生成框架,它用Layout- In-F u T ure control来补充相机控制,使用户能够指定未来视图中应该出现什么以及它应该出现在哪里.
这解决了在可控视频生成中的实际需要:由于有了初始图像,用户往往不仅关心相机的移动方式,而且关心镜头在未来关键时刻,特别是最终帧的外观.
现有的相机控制指定了视线轨迹,而文本提示则只提供粗糙的语义指导;两者都不确切确定未来视图的内容和空间布局.
在大角度的变化下,这种限制变得特别明显,在这种变化中,相机揭示出第一框架中不可见的区域。
因此,LIFT使用后帧布局作为希望未来场景的明确控制信号.
由于从这种稀少的布局指导中学习,比对密集的每帧布局的调节要具有更大的挑战性,因此我们引入了政策上的自我消化(OPSD),将密集放电老师的控制能力转移给最后一个放电的学生.
我们进一步管理 LIFT-Vista , 一个数据集,

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent advances in video generation foundation models ( Wan et al., 2025 ; HaCohen et al., 2026 ; Seedance et al., 2026 ) have greatly improved the ability to synthesize high-fidelity, temporally coherent videos from text prompts or a single reference image.
Yet precise controllability remains a major barrier to using these models as practical creative tools, especially when the desired camera motion extends far beyond the initial view.
As illustrated in fig. 1 , a creator may want the camera to move past the dining table and turn toward an unseen living room, while also specifying its composition—for example, a sofa facing the camera, a round coffee table in front of it, and a mirror above the fireplace.
Although these elements are not visible in the input image, their content and spatial layout determine what the newly revealed view should look like.
blocks.zh:
视频生成基础模型的最新进展(Wan等,2025;HaCohen等,2026;Seedance等,2026)大大提高了从文本提示或单一参考图像中合成高真实度,时间上一致的视频的能力.
然而,精确的可控性仍然是将这些模型用作实用的创造性工具的主要障碍,特别是当所期望的相机运动远远超出最初的视野时.
如图所显示. 1,创作者可能希望相机能从餐桌走过并转向一个看不见的客厅,同时也具体说明其组成——例如相机正面的沙发,前方的圆形咖啡桌和壁炉上方的一面镜子.
虽然这些元素在输入图像中不可见,但其内容和空间布局决定了新披露的视图应该是什么样子.

blocks.en:
Existing controllable video generation methods address only part of this problem.
Camera-controlled video generation ( He et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025a ; Team et al., 2026 ) conditions on a prescribed camera trajectory to determine how the viewpoint should move .
However, when large camera motion reveals substantial regions outside the reference view, their content remains unspecified: the camera trajectory alone cannot determine what should appear or where it should be placed .
Layout guidance offers a natural complementary control by explicitly specifying the semantic content and spatial composition of such future views.
blocks.zh:
现有的可控制视频生成方法只解决了这个问题的一部分.
相机控制视频生成(He等,2024;Bai等,2025a; Team et al., 2026)在规定相机轨迹上的条件,
然而,当大型相机运动显示参考视图以外的大面积区域时,其内容仍然不明:仅凭相机轨迹无法确定应当出现什么或放置在何处。
版式指导通过明确规定这些未来观点的语义内容和空间组成,提供了自然的补充控制.

blocks.en:
While layout-conditioned generation has been extensively studied for images ( Zhang et al., 2025c ; Huang et al., 2026 ) , it remains far less explored for video.
Existing video methods ( Li et al., 2025c ; Feng et al., 2025 ) typically rely on dense per-frame boxes, masks, or trajectories, and primarily focus on controlling the motion of objects already visible in the first frame.
Moreover, such dense frame-wise guidance places a substantial annotation burden on users.
blocks.zh:
虽然已广泛研究了以布局为条件的生成图象(张等,2025c;黄等,2026),但对视频的探索仍然少得多.
现有的视频方法(Li等,2025c;Feng等,2025)一般依靠密密的每帧相框,口罩,或轨迹,并主要注重控制一帧已可见物体的运动.
此外,这种密集的框式指导给用户带来了很大的注释负担。

blocks.en:
To address these problems, we introduce L ayout- I n- F u T ure (LIFT), a unified video generation framework for large viewpoint changes that supports both camera control and last-frame layout conditioning.
LIFT operates in two inference modes: a single-condition mode , conditioned only on the camera trajectory, and a dual-condition mode , conditioned on both the camera trajectory and the last-frame layout.
As shown in fig. 1 , LIFT enables users to control not only how the camera moves, but also what should appear in newly revealed regions and where it should appear.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这些问题,我们引入了L ayout -- I n -- F u T ure(LIFT),一个支持相机控制和后帧布局调节的大型视窗变化的统一视频生成框架.
LIFT以两种推论模式运作:单条件模式,仅以相机轨迹为条件;双条件模式,既以相机轨迹为条件,又以后帧布局为条件.
如来所显示. 1, LIFT 使用户不仅能够控制相机的移动方式,而且能够控制新曝光区域中应当出现的内容和出现地点.

blocks.en:
Learning from only a last-frame layout is challenging: without dense per-frame layout guidance, the model must infer how specified objects evolve with camera motion and how the observed scene transitions toward the target composition.
We find that direct training with last-frame-only layouts under standard supervised flow matching struggles to exploit the sparse layout condition, leading to inferior future-layout control, while progressively reducing layout density through SFT incurs substantial training cost with limited gains.
We therefore first train a dense-layout model and use it as a teacher to supervise the last-frame-layout student on its own rollout states through on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) .
Experiments demonstrate that OPSD achieves stronger layout control with fewer training sample updates than the SFT baselines.
Moreover, camera and layout conditioning are inherently coupled, as dense layouts also capture scene evolution induced by camera motion.
To exploit this coupling, we train a shared student across both the single-condition and dual-condition modes while distilling from the same dense-layout teacher.
This dual-mode training encourages the two forms of control to reinforce each other, improving both camera and future-layout controllability.
blocks.zh:
仅从最后一个帧布局中学习是具有挑战性的:没有密集的每帧布局指导,模型必须推断出特定物体是如何随着相机运动而演变的,以及观测到的场景如何向目标构成过渡.
我们发现,在标准监督的流量匹配条件下,直接进行仅限最后帧布局的培训,为利用稀疏布局条件而挣扎,导致未来排出控制低劣,同时通过SFT逐渐降低布局密度,需要花费大量培训费用,收益有限。
因此,我们首先培训一种密集放电模式,并用它作为教师,通过政策性自我放电(OPSD)监督自己推出的最后一个放电模式的学生(赵等,2026;江等,2026;李等,2026b)。
实验证明OPSD实现更强大的布局控制,培训样本更新比SFT基线少.
此外相机和布局调节是内在相接的,因为密集的布局也捕捉相机运动所引发的场景演化.
为了利用这种搭配,我们培养了一个共同的学生, 跨越单一条件和双重条件两种模式, 同时从同一个密集的教师那里蒸馏出来。
这种双模式训练鼓励两种控制形式相得益彰,既能提高相机的可控性,又能提高未来的可控性.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce LIFT , a unified video generation framework. It enables users to control both camera motion and the semantic-spatial composition of newly revealed regions using only a last-frame layout. • We introduce dual-mode OPSD to this task, using dense spatiotemporal layouts as privileged information to train a shared student in both single-condition and dual-condition modes. • We curate LIFT-Vista , a dataset tailored to large viewpoint changes.
Our automatic pipeline identifies videos with substantial future-region revelation and produces temporally consistent camera and layout annotations.

blocks.en: 2 Data: LIFT-Vista
blocks.zh: 2 数据:LIFT-Vista

blocks.en:
Existing datasets don’t directly support our target setting.
Camera-annotated video datasets ( Zhou et al., 2018 ; Li et al., 2026e ; Wang et al., 2025b ) generally lack object-level layout labels, whereas datasets with bounding-box or layout ( Li et al., 2025c ) typically lack camera trajectories and focus on the first-frame objects. We therefore curate LIFT-VISTA, a dataset specifically for future-view layout control under large viewpoint changes. Our data curation pipeline is illustrated in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh:
现有数据集并不直接支持我们的目标设定。
相机附加说明的相机数据集 (周克等,2018;李克等,2026e;王克等,2025b) 通常缺乏对象级别布局标签,而带有边框或布局的数据集(李克等,2025c)通常缺乏相机轨迹并注重一帧对象. 因此,我们管理LIFT-VISTA,这是一个数据集,专门用于在大视角变化下进行未来视图布局控制。 我们的数据整理流程如图2所示。

blocks.en:
Data Collection. We build LIFT-VISTA from RealEstate10K ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) , Sekai ( Li et al., 2026e ) , and SpatialVID ( Wang et al., 2025b ) .
The resulting data jointly provides camera trajectories and spatiotemporal object layouts, with an emphasis on scenes in which camera motion reveals regions outside the initial view.

由此产生的数据共同提供了相机轨迹和相机对象布局,强调相机运动揭示出初始视图外区域的场景.

blocks.en:

blocks.en: Data Annotation. For camera trajectories, we apply Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) to annotate camera intrinsics and extrinsics across all datasets, unifying coordinate systems. For spatiotemporal layout annotation, we first detect and annotate object-level bounding boxes in the last frame of each clip. Then, we use SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) to track these objects throughout the entire clip, producing dense per-frame layouts.
blocks.zh: 数据注释. 对于相机轨迹,我们应用"深度Anything 3"(Lin等,2025年)对所有数据集的内在相机和外相进行注释,统一坐标系统. 对于spatiotemporal布局注释,我们首先检测并注释每个剪辑后框中的对象级别边框. 然后,我们用SAM3(Carion等,2025年)在整个剪辑中跟踪这些物体,产生密集的每帧布局.

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminary
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况

blocks.en: Diffusion On-Policy Self-Distillation. OPSD uses the same model to act as both student and teacher. The student is conditioned only on the inference-time context c c , whereas the teacher additionally observes privileged information r r . In the LLM domain, the student is trained to match the teacher distribution using reverse KL. Recent works ( Fang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026d ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) study on-policy distillation for diffusion models. blocks.en:
Selective State Distillation. Not all states along the student rollout provide equally useful distillation signals.
The global spatial layout configuration is largely determined during the early, high-noise stage of the denoising trajectory ( Hertz et al., 2023 ) .
At these states, we observe that the teacher with privileged dense-layout conditioning can correct the student to the desired layout.
In contrast, at later low-noise states, the teacher produces nearly no corrections, making the corresponding distillation signal less informative.
We therefore concentrate OPSD supervision on the first 10 high-noise states of each student rollout.

选择性州分化. 并非所有的州 学生推出提供同样有用的蒸馏信号。
全球空间布局配置在去声轨迹的早期高噪阶段基本确定(Hertz等,2023.).
在这些州,我们观察到,拥有特权的密集排出调子的老师可以将学生改正为理想的布局.
相形之下,在后来的低噪状态下,老师几乎不产生校正,使得相应的分馏信号信息较少.
因此,我们把OPSD的监督集中在每个学生推出的最初10个高噪音状态。

blocks.en:
We build our model on top of Wan2.1-Fun-V1.1-1.3B-Control-Camera ( Wan et al., 2025 ) .
All experiments are conducted at a resolution of 352 × 640 352\times 640 , using 81-frame clips at 16 FPS.
Training is performed on 4 NVIDIA H100 GPUs.
For the three training stages, we optimize the model for 8,000, 4,000, and 500 steps, respectively.
The corresponding global batch sizes are 32, 32, and 16, with learning rates of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , and 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} .
We use AdamW as the optimizer.
For Stage 3, the sampling probabilities for the two OPSD modes are P ⁡ ( 𝒮 = { F } ) = 0.7 P(\mathcal{S}=\{F\})=0.7 and P ⁡ ( 𝒮 = ∅ ) = 0.3 P(\mathcal{S}=\emptyset)=0.3 for the lastframe-layout and camera-only modes, respectively.
For inference, we use 50 denoising steps and a cfg scale of 6.0.
More implementation details are included in section A.2.1 and section A.1 .

blocks.en:
Baselines. We compare against three categories of controllable video generation methods: camera control, object motion control, and joint camera-and-object motion control.
For camera control, we evaluate against two recent state-of-the-art methods, Uni3C ( Cao et al., 2025 ) and GEN3C ( Ren et al., 2025 ) .
For object motion control, we compare with MagicMotion ( Li et al., 2025c ) , which uses bounding-box trajectories to specify object motion.
We further include Direct-a-Video ( Yang et al., 2024 ) as a joint-control baseline.
Direct-a-Video supports training-free control of object motion using bounding-box trajectories, whereas its camera control is restricted to horizontal/vertical panning and zooming.
For a fair comparison to baselines, we provide MagicMotion and Direct-a-Video with dense per-frame layout trajectories, whereas our model uses only a last-frame layout.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: 5.1 Controllable Video Generation
blocks.zh: 5.1 可控视频生成

blocks.en:
Camera Control. Camera-controllable video generation ( Bahmani et al., 2025b ; Bai et al., 2025a ; Bai et al., 2025b ; Zheng et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025d ; Yu et al., 2025 ) aims to explicitly control viewpoint trajectory during synthesis.
Recent works use camera extrinsics ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Bai et al., 2025a ) , Plücker-ray embeddings ( He et al., 2024 ; Bahmani et al., 2025a ; He et al., 2025 ) , or explicit 3D priors ( Ren et al., 2025 ; Cao et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025d ) as camera representations and inject them into video diffusion models.
Some approaches also incorporate relative camera geometry into attention through positional encodings ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026c ) .
More recently, world models extend camera control towards long-horizon scene exploration ( Li et al., 2025a ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Mao et al., 2025 ; Team et al., 2026 ) .
However, these methods only determine how the viewpoint should move.
Our work complements camera control with object-level layout guidance, enabling explicit control of the semantic and spatial composition of future views beyond the initially observed regions.
blocks.zh:
相机控制中心. 相机可控视频生成(Bahmani等人,2025年b; Bai等,2025a;Bai等,2025b;Zheng等,2024;Li等,2025d;Yu等,2025)旨在明确控制合成过程中的视向轨迹。
近期作品使用相机外置相机(Wang等人,2024b;Bai等人,2025a),Plücker-ray嵌入相机. (He等,2024;Bahmani等,2025a; 他等,2025年),或明文3D前传(Ren等,2025年;Cao等,2025年;Wang等,2025年d)作为相机表示并注入视频传播模型.
一些方法还通过位置编码将相机相机相机几何纳入注意力(张等,2026;李等,2026c.).
最近,世界模型将相机控制扩展到长视距场景探索(Li等,2025a; Sun等,2026;Mao等,2025;Team等,2026.).
然而,这些方法只能决定观点应如何移动。
我们的工作以物体级布局指导来补充相机控制,从而能够明确控制最初观测到的区域以外的未来观点的语义和空间构成。

blocks.en:
Object Motion and Layout Control. Spatiotemporal control has been extensively studied for manipulating object motion. Video generation models use point trajectories ( Geng et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Gu et al., 2025 ) , bounding boxes ( Jain et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2025c ; Li et al., 2025c ) , or masks ( Wu et al., 2024b ; Yariv et al., 2025 ) to specify object motion over time.
Some works can also jointly control object motion and camera ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024a ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Xing et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) .
These methods specify how an object moves, but typically assume that the controlled object is already present in the first frame.
Relatedly, layout-conditioned generation specifies what objects should appear and where. While it has been widely explored in image generation ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2025c ; Huang et al., 2026 ) , it remains less explored in video generation.
Existing methods rely on dense per-frame object descriptions ( Li et al., 2025b ; Feng et al., 2025 ) , mainly targeting object motion.
In contrast, LIFT targets future-view layout control under large viewpoint changes, supporting last-frame-only layout conditioning.
blocks.zh:
对象运动和布局控制 。 对操纵物体运动的Spatiotemporal控制进行了广泛的研究. 视频生成模型采用点轨距(Geng等,2025;Wang等,2025a;Gu等,2025),边框(Jain等,2024;Wu等,2024a; Wang等,2025c;Li等,2025c),或口罩(Wu等,2024b;Yariv等,2025),以指定随时间推移的物体运动.
有些作品也可以联合控制物体运动和相机 (杨等,2024;吴等,2024a; Chen等,2025; Xing等,2025; Zheng等,2026.).
这些方法指定了物体如何移动,但通常假设受控物体已经存在于第一个帧.
与此相关的是,有布局条件的生成指定了哪些对象应该出现,在哪里出现. 虽然在图像生成中已广泛探索(Wang等,2024a; 张等,"2025a";张等,"2025c";"黄等","2026"),在视频生成中仍然较少被探索.
现有方法依赖密集的每帧对象描述 (Li等,2025b;Feng等,2025.),主要针对物体运动.
相形之下,LIFT在大视角变化下瞄准了未来-视图布局控制,支持了后一帧-仅限布局配置.

blocks.en: 5.2 On-Policy Self-Distillation
blocks.zh: 5.2 政策上的自我分裂

blocks.en:
On-policy distillation (OPD) ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) has recently emerged as an effective alternative post-training method complementary to SFT and RL.
OPD trains a student to match a teacher on trajectories generated by the student itself, thereby reducing the train–inference distribution mismatch of SFT.
Compared with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) such as GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , which typically relies on a scalar sequence-level reward, OPD offers dense token-level supervision from the teacher.
Recent works ( Fang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026d ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2026 ) extend this method to diffusion and flow-matching models.
On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) further uses the model itself as the teacher by providing it with richer context, known as privileged information, while the student receives only inference-time conditions.
It removes the need for a separately trained or larger teacher.
While OPSD has recently received increasing attention in LLMs, it remains relatively underexplored in image and video generation ( Li et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026 ) .
LIFT uses OPSD to achieve last-frame layout control and encourage the synergy between camera and layout conditioning.
blocks.zh:
政策上蒸馏法(OPD)(Agarwal等,2024年)最近成为补充SFT和RL的有效培训后替代方法.
OPD训练学生在学生自己产生的轨迹上与老师相匹配,从而减少SFT的列车-推论分配不匹配.
相较于GRPO(Shao等,2024年)等具有可核查奖励(RLVR)的强化学习,通常依靠分级序列级的奖励,OPD从老师那里提供密集的符号级监督.
近代著作(Fang等,2026;Li等,2026d;Zhou等,2026;Xu等,2026;Fu等,2026)将这种方法延伸至扩散和流相匹配模型.
On-political自沉(OPSD)(赵等,2026;蒋等,2026)进一步将模型本身作为老师,为其提供更丰富的上下文,称为特权信息,而学生只获得推断时间条件.
它免除了单独培训或扩大教师的需要。
虽然OPSD在LLMs中最近受到越来越多的关注,但在图像和视频生成方面仍然相对没有得到充分利用(Li等,2026b;Liu等,2026.).
LIFT使用OPSD实现上帧布局控制,并鼓励相机和布局配置之间的协同.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduce LIFT, a unified framework for future-view layout control under large viewpoint changes.
LIFT enables users to control both camera motion and the semantic and spatial composition of newly revealed regions through two inference modes: a single mode conditioned on the camera trajectory and a dual mode additionally conditioned on the last-frame layout.
To support this setting, we curate LIFT-Vista, a dataset featuring substantial future-region revelation with temporally consistent camera and layout annotations.
To effectively learn from sparse last-frame layout guidance, we adopt on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) and apply it in a dual-mode training scheme, transferring privileged dense-layout knowledge to a shared student across both inference modes.
Together, these designs improve camera and future-layout controllability within a unified video generation framework.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们引入了LIFT,这是在大视角变化下进行未来视野布局控制的统一框架.
LIFT使用户能够通过两种推论模式来控制相机运动以及新曝光区域的语义和空间组成:以相机轨迹为条件的单一模式和以上个帧布局为附加条件的双模式.
为了支持这一设定,我们整理了LIFT-Vista,这是一个数据集,它以时间上一致的相机和布局说明为主要内容,展现出大量的未来区域启示.
为了有效地学习有限的最后框架布局指导,我们采用了政策上的自我消化(OPSD),并将其应用到双模式的培训计划中,通过两种推论模式向共享的学生传授特权的密集放电知识。
这些设计共同改善了相机和在统一的视频生成框架内的未来放出可控性.

Then, we extract candidate windows from source videos.
To match our training configuration, each source video is resampled to 16 fps and cut into 81-frame windows ( ≈ 5 \approx 5 s) with a stride of 40 frames.

blocks.en: We evaluate the generated videos along three dimensions: visual quality, camera controllability, and layout controllability.
blocks.zh: 我们按三个维度来评估生成的视频:视觉质量,相机可控性和布局可控性.

blocks.en:
Visual quality. We report Fréchet Video Distance (FVD) ( Unterthiner et al., 2018 ) ,
Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) , and
Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) .
FVD measures the distributional discrepancy between generated and real videos in a learned video feature space, jointly reflecting visual realism and temporal coherence.
FID measures the distributional similarity between generated and real frames in the image feature space and primarily evaluates frame-level visual fidelity.
LPIPS measures the perceptual distance between generated and corresponding reference frames using deep visual features.
Lower values indicate better performance for all three metrics.
blocks.zh:
视觉品质. 我们报告Fréchet视频距离(FVD)(Unterthiner等,2018年),
Fréchet Inception距离(FID)(Heusel等人,2017年),以及
学习感知影像补丁相似性(LPIPS)(张等,2018.
FVD在学习到的视频特写空间中测量出生成的和真实的视频的分布差异,共同反映视觉现实主义和时间一致性.
FID测量图像特征空间中生成与真实帧的分布相似性,并主要评价帧级视觉忠诚性.
LPIPS使用深视特征测量生成和相应参考框架之间的感知距离.
数值较低表明所有三个衡量标准的业绩都较好。

blocks.en:
Camera controllability. Following ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) ,
we evaluate camera trajectory accuracy using rotation error (RotErr) and translation error (TransErr).
RotErr measures the angular discrepancy between the estimated camera rotations of the generated video and the target camera trajectory, while TransErr measures their translation discrepancy. We use the off-the-shelf model ( Lin et al., 2025 ) to estimate the camera pose of generated videos and then compare with the ground truth.
Lower RotErr and TransErr indicate more accurate adherence to the prescribed camera motion.

相机可控性. 后 (张等,2025b.),.
我们用旋转错误(RotErr)和翻译错误(TransErr)来评价相机轨迹精度。
RotErr测量生成视频的估计相机旋转与目标相机轨迹之间的角相差,而TransErr测量其翻译相差. 我们用现成的模型(Lin等,2025年)来估计生成的视频的相机姿势,然后与地面真相进行比较.

blocks.en:
Layout controllability. Following OverLayBench ( Li et al., 2026a ) , we evaluate object-level spatial and semantic control using mean Intersection over Union (mIoU), Success Rate of Entity (SR e ), and CLIP local ( Radford et al., 2021 ) . We use Qwen3.6-27B ( Bai et al., 2025c ) to detect objects and their locations in the generated videos.
mIoU measures the spatial overlap between generated object regions and their target layout boxes, reflecting object placement accuracy.
SR e measures the fraction of conditioned entities that are successfully generated with the intended semantics and spatial placement.
CLIP local computes the CLIP similarity between local regions corresponding to conditioned objects and their text descriptions, measuring local semantic consistency.
Higher mIoU, SR e , and CLIP local indicate better layout controllability.

blocks.en:
Any Layout Sparsity. As shown in table 6 , LIFT supports different layout sparsity at inference without retraining.
Providing more layout frames generally improves generation quality, spatial alignment and semantic consistency.
These results demonstrate that LIFT can leverage additional layout guidance when available, allowing users to trade annotation effort for finer spatial control while retaining the practical last-frame-only interface.
blocks.zh:
任意布局平缓 。 如表6所示,LIFT支持不同布局的推论而无需再培训.
提供更多布局框架一般能提高生成质量,空间相接性和语义一致性.
这些结果表明,LIFT在可获得时可以利用额外的布局指导,允许用户在保留实用的仅限帧界面的同时,用注释来进行更细化的空间控制.

blocks.en:
SFT vs. OPSD. A more detailed training cost comparison between SFT and OPSD is illustrated in table 7 . OPSD is substantially more data-efficient and effective at achieving the last-frame layout control.
The qualitative comparisons in fig. 7 illustrate the layout-following limitations of the evaluated SFT baselines in our setting.
Because the last-frame layout provides only a weak endpoint signal, direct last-frame SFT often ignores conditioned objects.
Dense-to-sparse SFT partially alleviates this issue, but the model still has to infer, from the last-frame layout alone, how the specified objects should emerge and evolve throughout the preceding frames under camera motion.
In contrast, OPSD provides direct supervision from a dense-layout teacher on the student’s own rollout states, supplying explicit guidance for the intermediate scene evolution and making the sparse future-layout condition substantially easier to learn.

SFT对OPSD. 表7较详细地比较了SFT与OPSD的培训费用。 OPSD对于实现上个帧布局控制来说,数据效率高,效果好得多.
无花果的质量比较。 7说明了我们设定时评估的SFT基线在布局上的局限性。
由于上方帧布局只提供弱端点信号,直接上方帧SFT经常会忽略有条件的对象.
Dense-to-sparse SFT在一定程度上缓解了这个问题,但模型仍需要从上个帧的布局中单独推断出特定物体应如何在相机运动下在整个前个帧中出现并演化出.
相比之下,OPSD则提供由密集放电的教师对学生自身推出状态进行直接监督,为中间场景演化提供明确指导,并让稀少的未来放电条件大大地更容易被学习.

blocks.en:
Dual-mode OPSD. The qualitative comparisons are shown in fig. 8 .
Lastframe-layout single-mode OPSD learns to follow the future layout, but specializing only to this conditioning mode can yield lower visual quality than dual-mode OPSD under camera-only inference, e.g., causing scene drift or geometric distortion.
Conversely, camera-only single-mode OPSD maintains strong camera-conditioned generation but lacks sufficient supervision for future-layout control, often producing incorrect objects or failing to place them at the specified locations.
By alternating between both modes and distilling from the same dense-layout teacher, dual-mode OPSD preserves camera controllability while retaining accurate future-layout control, leading to more consistent behavior across both inference settings.
blocks.zh:
双模式 OPSD. 质量比较以无花果表示。 8 (英语).
Lastframe-layout single-mode OPSD 学习遵循未来的布局,但仅专门使用这种调制模式就可以产生比相机唯一推断下的双模 OPSD 更低的视觉质量,例如引起场景漂移或几何扭曲.
反之,只摄相机单相机 OPSD维持了强大的相机条件生成,但缺乏对未来放电控制的充分监督,经常产生不正确的物体或者没有将它们放置在指定地点.
通过在模式和从同一位密集放电老师中分馏的交替,双相模 OPSD 保留相机可控性,同时保留准确的未来放电控制,导致两种推论设置的行为更加一致.

blocks.en:
ODE State Sampling Strategy in OPSD. We study where along the ODE trajectory the teacher provides the most effective distillation signal.
As visualized in fig. 9 , during the early high-noise stage, the dense-layout teacher produces clear corrections to the student-visited state, especially in the global object layout and spatial arrangement.
In contrast, after roughly the first 10 denoising steps, the student and teacher predictions become much closer, and the teacher correction is significantly weaker and provides less informative distillation signals.
As shown in table 8 , prefix-state distillation provides a favorable trade-off between training time, camera accuracy, and spatial layout control.
Based on this observation, we select the first 10 high-noise rollout states for OPSD.
This selective state sampling focuses optimization on the phase where the global layout structure is established while reducing the cost of student rollout and distillation.
This ablation is conducted on lastframe-layout single-mode OPSD.
Distilling only the last 10 states performs substantially worse across all quality and controllability metrics, indicating that low-noise states provide little useful signal for correcting the global layout.
In contrast, supervising the prefix 10 high-noise states yields substantially better camera and layout control.
Combined with the SFT anchor, prefix-10-state distillation achieves the strongest overall performance while introducing little computation overhead.
This is substantially more efficient than querying all 50 rollout states.
These results support our observation that the dense-layout teacher provides its most informative corrections during the early high-noise stage, where the global scene and layout structure are primarily established. Visualization comparisons are shown in fig. 10 .
blocks.zh:
OPSD中的ODE国家采样战略. 我们研究在ODE轨迹上 老师提供最有效的蒸馏信号
以无花果为可视. 9,在早期高噪阶段,密集放出老师对被学生访问的状态产生清晰的校正,特别是在全球物体布局和空间安排方面.
相形之下,在大致经过了前十个去名步骤之后,学生和老师的预测变得相去甚远,老师的校正能力也大大地弱了,提供了信息较少的分馏信号.
如表8所示,前缀状态蒸馏在训练时间,相机精度,和空间布局控制之间提供了有利的取舍.
基于这一观察,我们为OPSD选择了前10个高噪声展开状态.
这种选择性的状态采样将优化重点放在建立全球布局结构的阶段,同时降低学生推出和蒸馏的成本.
这种放电是在最后帧放出单模的OPSD上进行的.
在所有质量和控制性指标中,只有最后10个州表现严重恶化,这表明低噪音州对纠正全球布局没有多大用处。
相形之下,监督前缀10高噪状态,则大大改善了相机和布局控制.
与SFT锚地结合后,前缀-10-状态蒸馏实现最强的整体性能,同时引入的计算间接费用很少.
这比查询所有50个推出州要高效得多。
这些结果支持了我们的看法,即密集排出教师在早期高噪音阶段提供了最翔实的校正,全球场景和布局结构主要在此地建立. 可视化比较以图10显示。

blocks.en:
Data Filtering. Table. 9 and Fig. 11 demonstrate the effectiveness of our camera-motion filtering strategy.
For a fair comparison, we construct two equally sized training sets of 30K clips, one using our proposed filtering strategy and the other using random sampling.
We additionally hold out a test set of 250 clips featuring substantial future-region revelation.
Compared with random sampling, our filtered training data consistently improves all evaluation metrics, including video quality and camera-control accuracy, and better preserves scene structure and object appearance under large viewpoint changes.
These results highlight the importance of curating training data with large viewpoint changes for our target setting.
blocks.zh:
数据过滤。  Table表. 9和图11显示了我们的相机运动过滤策略的有效性.
为了进行公平的比较,我们建造了两套同样大小的由30K个剪辑组成的训练套,一套采用我们提议的过滤策略,另一套采用随机抽样。
此外,我们还有一套包含250个片段的测试,这些片段展现出未来区域的重大启示。
与随机取样相比,我们经过过滤的培训数据不断改进所有评价指标,包括视频质量和相机控制精度,并在大视野变化下更好地保存场景结构和物体外观.
这些结果突出表明,必须用大范围的观点来分析培训数据,改变我们的目标设定。

blocks.en: A.2.4 User Study
blocks.zh: A.2.4 用户研究

blocks.en:
To complement automatic evaluation, we conduct a randomized user study with 7 participants.
For each trial, participants are shown the input condition and anonymized generated videos from different methods in random order, and are asked to choose the result that best satisfies the control intent, considering camera motion, layout adherence, object consistency, and visual quality.
We compare with the best two methods in table 1 in this user study.
Each participant evaluates 30 comparisons, yielding 210 responses in total.
Participants may also select a “None preferred” option, and the reported preference rates are computed over responses that select one of the three methods.
As shown in table 10 , our method achieves the highest preference rate, 65.96%.
This result indicates that the advantages of our method are not only reflected in automatic metrics but are also perceptible to human observers.
The user study further confirms that our approach produces visually convincing and controllable videos that better align with user intent.
blocks.zh:
为了补充自动评价,我们进行了随机的用户研究,有7人参加。
对每次试验,参与者都按随机顺序显示不同方法的输入条件和匿名生成的视频,并被要求选择最能满足控制意图的结果,考虑相机运动,布局守恒,物体一致性,和视觉质量.
我们比较了本用户研究表1中最好的两种方法.
每个参与者评价30个比较,总共得到210个答复。
与会者也可选择“无首选”办法,所报告的优先率比选择三种方法之一的答复要高。
如表10所示,我们的方法实现了最高优惠率,65.96%。
这一结果表明,我们方法的优点不仅反映在自动计量中,而且对人类观察家来说也是可以理解的。
用户研究进一步证实,我们的方法产生了视觉上有说服力和可控制的视频,更符合用户意图。

blocks.en: A.3 Limitation
blocks.zh: A.3 限制

blocks.en: LIFT currently uses 2D bounding boxes with local text prompts to specify the desired future-view composition. Although this representation is simple and user-friendly, it provides only coarse spatial constraints and does not explicitly capture depth, orientation, or occlusion relationships between objects. Extending the layout representation with richer geometric or instance-level controls could enable more fine-grained specification of future views.
blocks.zh: LIFT目前使用有本地文本提示的2D边框来指定所期望的未来视图组成. 虽然这种表述简单易用,但只提供了粗糙的空间限制,没有明确捕捉到物体之间的深度,取向,或隐蔽关系. 用更丰富的几何或实例级控制来扩大布局代表,可以使未来观点更加细微地具体化。
